subject: PO requirement for AstraGrid pilot — invoice-only exception request
messages:
From: Jordan Frye <jordan.frye@astragrid.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
Cc: AstraGrid Procurement <procure@astragrid.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. We have a small, 6-week technical pilot with Redwood (AstraGrid internal team) and our procurement cycle won't issue a PO until after the pilot completes. To avoid delaying the trial, can Redwood allow a temporary invoice-only onboarding path for AstraGrid so we can proceed? We can provide the vendor intake form, a PO commitment letter that follows the pilot, and a purchase order once procurement is done.

Key details:
- Pilot estimate: $3,200 total (monthly invoicing preferred)
- Legal: signed SLA required
- Billing contact: finance@astragrid.ai

Happy to provide any paperwork — attaching the onboarding checklist we usually send to vendors. Can we expedite?

Cheers,
Jordan Frye
Head of Integrations
AstraGrid

Attachment: astra_vendor_intake_checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com

Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilot

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the checklist.

We can consider a short-term invoice-only path for pilots, provided we have a completed vendor onboarding form, a signed SLA, and a clear spend cap. I've looped in Marcus (procurement) and Naomi (finance) to confirm the evidence we need and an approval window.

Next steps from our side:
- Marcus: confirm required evidence and any additional contract language.
- Naomi: confirm whether finance can accept monthly invoices for a pilot and escrow conditions.
- Jordan: please complete the attached Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form and provide the expected billing cadence.

If we can get the form + signed SLA by Tuesday EOD we should be able to approve a temporary invoice-only flow for the duration of the pilot.

Thanks — Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Stephanie / Jordan — a few procurement items to confirm before we can issue an exception: 

1) Evidence: completed vendor onboarding form (we'll need tax ID or W-8/W-9 as applicable), copy of corporate insurance, and the signed SLA.
2) Spend cap and billing cadence: confirm monthly cap (Jordan mentioned ~$3,200 total) and whether AstraGrid will accept invoicing net-30.
3) Internal approval: I need a written commitment from sales (Stephanie) listing the pilot dates, expected trial endpoints, and who owns the PO once procurement completes.

If all items are provided, procurement can provisionally approve an "invoice-only" account for up to 8 weeks with a hard spend cap and auto-block if invoices go past the cap. We'll prepare a short exception memo.

I'm attaching the onboarding form we prefer to receive filled out to speed review.

Thanks — Marcus Lin
Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

- Completed vendor form: attached (astragrid_onboarding_form.pdf)
- Tax ID: 82-3394452 (US entity)

Best,
Jordan Frye
Head of Integrations, AstraGrid

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for providing the documents. Finance and procurement have reviewed the materials. We will approve a conditional invoice-only onboarding for the AstraGrid pilot under the following conditions:

1) Spend cap of $3,200 total is enforced. Account will be blocked automatically if cumulative invoices exceed cap.
2) Invoices must reference "Pilot Invoice — Redwood Test Account" and be emailed to finance@redwood.example.com with a cc to finance@astragrid.ai.
3) Net-30 terms accepted for pilot period only. If invoices remain unpaid beyond net-30, account access will be suspended.
4) Complete PO must be delivered by 2026-08-01. If not received, Redwood will pause further provisioning until procurement issues are resolved.
5) Signed SLA must be returned via DocuSign. I have created an embedded signing link: https://docusign.example.com/embedded-sign/ABCD-1234

Actions:
- Marcus will generate a short exception memo (JIRA:PROC-942) and set the account flag.
- Stephanie: please confirm provisioning window once the exception memo is in place.
- Jordan: sign SLA via the DocuSign link and send the first invoice when pilot billing begins.

Thanks — Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
